brief: Goldman's US equities desk recap for 22 Sep 2026. The dominant desk theme: Agentic AI disruption, following Meta's Muse launch, is driving hedge fund shorts in "Consumer Inertia" names, companies whose retention rests on behavioral, operational, contractual or financial switching costs. The GSXUSWCH basket fell 2.58%, with PLNT, NYT, SCHW, ALL and INTU among the biggest decliners; XLF also sold off on the same AI-disruption risk. Desk flow was net-for-sale (activity 3/10, -871bps), with both asset managers ($857mm) and hedge funds ($953mm) better for sale, concentrated in communication services and consumer discretionary. Separately, NDX closed at a record (its fourth straight up day) while SPX finished flat on below-average volume. In derivatives, NDX vol was bid and lifted off summer lows, SPX vol was offered with skew crushed, and the desk favors VIX Oct 20 calls for cheap convexity ahead of Meta Connect and the MCD/AUR investor days. Oil extended a five-day relief rally on Iran Strait-of-Hormuz de-escalation headlines; Trump cited deal "momentum" after earlier saying no Iran deal was likely before the midterms.
